items: Changing a rung template `EncWarlock0{2–7}TemplateConjurer` also needs that rung's boss template `EncWarlock0NTemplateBossConjurer` (7 · 14 · 21 · 30 · 40 · 50, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as its template but not for `Stats`. One exception: `EncWarlock03TemplateBossConjurer` 0E0FC3 hangs off the rung-02 template 06D22F, not 06D230, so changing 06D22F needs both the 02 and 03 Conjurer bosses and 06D230 needs neither.

Changing `EncWarlock01TemplateConjurer` 06D22E also needs `ccMTYSSE002_Enforcer` 000820:ccmtysse002-ve.esl (the Vigil Enforcer, 25, on Factions → Vigilants → *Named Vigilants*), through its leaf `EncWarlockAtro01ImperialF`, and `dunFolgunthurDaynas` 04CEDF (Daynas Valen's corpse, PC×0.75 [–25], left out as a corpse on the *Warlocks* group page), through `TreasCorpseWarlockDarkElfMale` 01A768 and the leaf `EncWarlockAtro01DarkElfM`: same pattern.

Changing `EncWarlock00Template` 044CCC (the shared base of every rung template, which uses it without `Stats`) also needs `WIChangeLocation04Student` 06F214 (1, left out as not an enemy on the *Warlocks* group page): same pattern.

Records filed elsewhere that do carry `Stats` from a rung-01 Conjurer leaf, so they move with `EncWarlock01TemplateConjurer`: the corpses on the group page's *Never met* list (`TreasCorpseWarlock*`, `TreasCorpseAlchemist`, `DLC1LD_BookCorpse1`, the Nchuand-Zel dead).
Every other record here (the rung leaves and every Conjurer wrapper) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
